{DRAFT}
⌈
The interface
ara::crypto::cryp::Symmet-
ricBlockCipherCtx::GetTransformation
shall return the
ara::crypto::
CryptoTransform

ara::crypto::cryp::
SymmetricBlockCipherCtx::SetKey

•

shall return a
CryptoErrorDomain::kUnini-
tializedContext
error, if
ara::crypto::cryp::SymmetricBlockCi-
pherCtx::SetKey
was never called.
⌋
